scope: offline patch only; no tracked implementation edits or live actions
decisions: Operator-only listener cancels only its own attempt-1 original run after exact RC/report/tag/policy/official exclusive reviewer rejection validation.
Record rejected and queue candidate_rejected before POST cancel; cancellation outside journal CAS retries.
Preserve completed/superseded/cancelled/evaluation_failed states, publication intent, receipt, active preparation; technical failures without rejected review leave state/run unchanged.
No approval or publication changes and no Slack secret on listeners; actions write only listener jobs plus reusable caller capability.
Default workflow_run observer remains read-only for run effects.

observed_changes: At most 3 short GETs / 3-second budget observing owner sent; immutable identity mismatch fails closed.
Unknown or racing reservation never causes another chat.postMessage; transient unconfirmed result remains optional blocked.
Sanitized confirmation timeout errors; durable unknown and sent checkpoint semantics unchanged.

limitations: GitHub runtime scheduling and self-cancel endpoint must still be proved live in a fresh candidate whose source workflows match trusted main.
The final intent/race exclusion relies on the same short release-lab-mutation job lock as prepare/publish/recovery.
A listener cancelled by its own POST may not upload its artifact; rejected journal/event are durable before cancellation.
